lessons.lessonTitle: 第一课 田芳去哪儿了
lessons.lessonTitleEn: Lesson 1 Where has Tian Fang gone

sentences.en: Hello, is this Tian Fang?
Tian Fang isn't here.
It's Zhang Dong, right?
Aunt, hello!
Where has Tian Fang gone?

sentences.cn: 她四点多就去同学家了。
sentences.en: She went to a classmate's home a little after four.

sentences.cn: 她的一个中学同学要出国，她去看看她。
sentences.en: One of her middle-school classmates is going abroad, so she went to see her off.
When will she be back?

sentences.cn: 她没说，你打她的手机吧。
sentences.en: She didn't say; just call her mobile phone.
I called, but her phone was off.
Is that so?
Call her again in a little while.
Aunt, has Tian Fang come back yet?
Not yet.
Mom, I'm back.
You must be hungry, right?
Hurry up and eat!

sentences.cn: 啊，对了，张东给你打电话了，没有？
sentences.en: Oh, right—Zhang Dong called you, didn't he?
No, he didn't.

sentences.cn: 他来电话找你，说打你的手机，你关机了。
sentences.en: He called looking for you; he said he called your mobile, but it was off.
Ah! Right, I forgot to turn on my phone.

sentences.cn: 快！电话又响了，你去接吧。
sentences.en: Quick! The phone is ringing again—go answer it.

sentences.cn: 喂，张东，下午你给我打电话了吧？
sentences.en: Hello, Zhang Dong, you called me this afternoon, right?
I did. Why was your phone off?
Sorry, I forgot to turn on my phone.
What did you do this afternoon?
I went to play football.

sentences.cn: 今天我们跟留学生代表队比赛了。
sentences.en: Today we played a match against the international students' team.
Your team lost again, didn't you?
No.
This time we won.
What was the score?
Two to one.
Congratulations to you all!
Hey, do you have something to ask?

sentences.cn: 我想问问你，你不是要上托福班吗？
sentences.en: I want to ask you—weren't you going to take the TOEFL class?
Have you signed up?
I've already signed up.
Do you also want to take the TOEFL test?
Yes.

sentences.cn: 我想明天去报名，你陪我一起去，好吗？
sentences.en: I want to go sign up tomorrow; will you come with me?
OK / All right.

sentences.cn: 大夫：化验结果出来了吗？
sentences.en: Doctor: Are the test results out?
Patient: Yes, they are.

sentences.cn: 病人：大夫，我是不是得了肠炎？
sentences.en: Patient: Doctor, do I have enteritis?

sentences.cn: 大夫：我看了化验结果。不是肠炎，只是消化不好。先给你开一些药，再给你打一针。
sentences.en: Doctor: I've looked at the results. It's not enteritis, just poor digestion. First I'll prescribe some medicine, then give you an injection.
Patient: How do I take this medicine?

sentences.cn: 罗兰：玛丽，你怎么哭了？病了吗？
sentences.en: Roland: Mary, why are you crying? Are you sick?

sentences.cn: 玛丽：不是。想家了。因为感到寂寞，所以心情不好，很难过。
sentences.en: Mary: No. I'm homesick. Because I feel lonely, I'm in a bad mood and very sad.
Roland: Don't be sad.

sentences.cn: 玛丽：我有姐姐，还有弟弟。在家时，我们常常一起玩儿，所以感到寂寞时总想他们。
sentences.en: Mary: I have an older sister and a younger brother. At home we used to play together often, so when I feel lonely I always miss them.

sentences.cn: 罗兰：今天晚上礼堂有舞会，我们一起去跳跳舞吧。玩儿玩儿就好了。
sentences.en: Roland: There's a dance in the auditorium tonight; let's go dance together. You'll feel better after enjoying yourself.
Mary: When shall we go?

sentences.cn: 罗兰：吃了晚饭就去吧。你在宿舍等我，我来叫你。
sentences.en: Roland: Let's go after dinner. Wait for me in the dorm; I'll come get you.
